conservation.condition_narrative: The work is complete and stable overall. Pencil media is secure and stable. The beige wove support paper has many amber fiber inclusions. These should not be mistaken for deterioration. The folded and opposite open edges have a number of slight creases. The open edges opposite the fold have a slight concave curvature and exhibit overall yellowing and discoloration. There are isolated stains, scuffs, and accretions across the lower third of the drawing.
conservation.technical_description:
**Support:** The support is a moderately thick, beige, moderately textured, wove drawing paper. 
 
 
 
**Ground or Support Preparation:** Other than the sizing, there is no additional support preparation. 
 
 
 
**Design Layers:** The design layer consists of graphite, applied with varying pressure to complete the design. 
 
 
 
**Surface Coating:** There is no surface coating. 
 
 
 
**Framing, Backing, and Hanging Hardware:** The drawing is installed in a whitewashed maple frame with a secondary basswood backing strainer. The entire framing package consists of a micro-environmentally controlled package containing the artwork, with a micro-chamber board sealed with Marvelseal. This package rests on a foam core base over the strainer. The frame holds the Optium glazing in front of the artwork. Attached to the strainer are mirror hangers and "T" bolt security hardware for use during the exhibition. The artwork is hinged to a drop-back, window backing mat with mulberry fiber paper hinges passed to the verso of the drop-back and secured with wheat starch paste and a mulberry paper T. The drop-back is secured to the surrounding backing mat with acid-free paper tape. The window mat is hinged to the backing mat, and the entire package is backed with a micro-chamber corrugated board and sealed to the Optium glazing using Marvelseal and J-Lar tape.

description: Graphite sketch of the head of a young woman (the artist's sister) in profile, facing toward the left side of the paper. The head is positioned slightly to the right of the center of the paper and  is surrounded by negative space. The area immediately behind the neck is shaded and the shoulders are lightly sketched in. Dated and signed directly beneath the lower right of the drawing.
title: Untitled (Ida O'Keeffe)
